purpose: Phase 1.1 battery-only view; frozen original trips, battery eligibility, separate metadata and feature matrices.
gap_reason: Median row interval is 0.25s, p99 about 0.75s; break at >1s conservatively. This is row continuity, not sensor refresh frequency.
voltage_reason: Existing EDA review threshold against nominal 360V documentation, not a manufacturer validity limit.
temperature_reason: Raw pack fields cluster at -1 while other channels use unavailable codes. Treat this narrow band as unresolved, not physically impossible; retain in audit and exclude from conditional experiments.
split_reason: Closest cumulative-row boundaries between whole trips on different UTC dates with at least lookback+horizon+tolerance separation; same-vehicle temporal evaluation only.
duplicate_reason: Conservative cross-split rounded-vector screen; later matches to any earlier split are withheld. It is not proof of independent states or an exhaustive near-neighbor search.

energy.reason: Current polarity, charging/regeneration identification and independently verified energy accounting remain unresolved; no energy labels exported.

typical_interval_reason: Descriptive ±0.05s band around observed 0.25s median; flagged only, not excluded.
battery_peer_temperature_review: Preserve existing battery-pack sentinel/absolute-zero checks on sensors 1/2/4; motor temperature never blocks this view.
